title: Steam Top Games Player Counts
description: Fetches current and peak concurrent player counts for the top 100 Steam games using the public Steam Charts data. Tracks player engagement in real time for games published by publicly traded companies (EA, Take-Two, Ubisoft, Activision-Blizzard, Valve, etc.). A game hemorrhaging players in week 2 post-launch signals a revenue miss; a catalog title surging signals an earnings beat. Trend with streamstats over time to detect engagement inflection points weeks before quarterly reports. Maps each game to its publisher for portfolio-level aggregation. No API key required.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

# Steam public API - top played games with concurrent player counts
resp = requests.get(
    'https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamChartsService/GetMostPlayedGames/v1/',
    timeout=30,
)
resp.raise_for_status()
data = resp.json()

ranks = data.get('response', {}).get('ranks', [])

rows = []
for entry in ranks:
    app_id = entry.get('appid', 0)
    current = entry.get('concurrent_in_game', 0)
    peak = entry.get('peak_in_game', 0)

    peak_ratio = round(current / peak, 4) if peak > 0 else 0.0

    if current >= 100000:
        engagement_tier = 'MASSIVE'
    elif current >= 25000:
        engagement_tier = 'HIGH'
    elif current >= 5000:
        engagement_tier = 'MODERATE'
    else:
        engagement_tier = 'LOW'

    rows.append({
        'app_id': app_id,
        'rank': entry.get('rank', 0),
        'concurrent_players': current,
        'peak_today': peak,
        'peak_ratio': peak_ratio,
        'engagement_tier': engagement_tier,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('rank').reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
